label: Wedding Planning Team
blurb: A Wedding Planning Director and 5 specialists who coordinate a wedding’s budget, vendors, guests, design, and schedule
purpose: Created for individuals, families, and organizers looking for dedicated support with wedding planning. Coordinate a wedding’s budget, vendors, guests, design, and schedule. The team takes care of preparation, detailed planning, and practical follow-through to keep everything running smoothly.

project.name: Wedding Planning
project.goal: Deliver a comprehensive initial wedding planning plan with clear milestones, assigned responsibilities, and verified outputs.
